GAB.note: A convention for two data centres was signed in June 2025; none is stated in service.

facts.fact: ANINF's director general, who coordinates eGabon-SIS, said the president presided over signing a convention for two data centres to guarantee Gabon's sovereignty over its digital data, and called for data governance, storage and deletion mechanisms to be put in place.

GAB.note: The SIS is a hospital information system at hospitals; the source does not say it holds the clinical record or does routine aggregate reporting.

facts.fact: The health ministry is rolling out its eGabon-SIS health information system, live in two pilot hospitals since a phase one provisionally accepted on 20 December 2024, with eight more hospitals entering production from July 2025, and the minister says it will give real-time data for steering public health.

GAB.note: ANINF's director general is technical coordinator of eGabon-SIS, but the source does not say ANINF staff build or run it.
No nationally owned data centre for hire in service stated.
